episodes.title: The Qualifiers 1
episodes.summary: The best dancers in the world battle for a $1 million prize before judges Jennifer Lopez, NE-YO, Derek Hough and host/mentor Jenna Dewan Tatum.

episodes.title: The Qualifiers 2
episodes.summary: In the second night of the Qualifiers, judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough and NE-YO weigh in on the performances of The Lab, Fik-Shun, Miami All Stars, Quick Style, Nick Daniels and more.

episodes.title: The Qualifiers 3
episodes.summary: In the final night of the Qualifiers, judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough and NE-YO decide whether Jabbawockeez, Swing Latino, DNA, Chapkis Dance Family and more will move on to the Duels.

episodes.title: The Duels 1
episodes.summary: Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough and NE-YO preside over the first night of Duels, with Fik-Shun vs. Nick Daniels, Swing Latino vs. Miami All Stars, Eva Igo vs. Kyntay and Keone & Mari vs. Quick Style.

episodes.title: The Duels 2
episodes.summary: The judges preside over the second night of Duels, with Diana Pombo vs. The Posse, Super Cr3w vs. Royal Flux, The Lab vs. Boys of Temecula and Les Twins vs. Kyle Van Newkirk.

episodes.title: The Duels 3
episodes.summary: The top qualifying acts from each division will choose a rival and face off in a head-to-head elimination duel; the judges score each act based on their artistry, precision and athleticism; the top scoring acts move forward in the competition.

episodes.title: The Cut 1
episodes.summary: The judges score each act's performance based on artistry, precision and athleticism, with the top two acts from each division advancing; guest judge Misty Copeland.

episodes.title: The Cut 2
episodes.summary: The judges score each act's performance based on artistry, precision and athleticism, with the top two acts from each division advancing; guest judge Misty Copeland.

episodes.title: Divisional Final
episodes.summary: The top two acts from each division compete for a spot in the world final.

episodes.title: World Final
episodes.summary: The final three acts compete to be the first ``World of Dance'' champion and win the $1 million grand prize.

episodes.title: The Callbacks
episodes.summary: "The Callbacks" begin with judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough and NE-YO. Acts that received a callback during "The Qualifiers" have one last chance to showcase their artistry, precision and athleticism to move forward and earn a spot in "The Duels," where they'll earn their right to perform on the iconic "World of Dance" stage and ultimately win a grand prize of $1 million dollars.

episodes.title: The Duels 1
episodes.summary: The Duels round begins with judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough, NE-YO and special guest judge dancer and choreographer tWitch.

episodes.title: The Semi-finals 1
episodes.summary: In the "Semi-Final 1," six of the top twelve acts take to the iconic World of Dance stage for the first time this season with judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough, NE-YO and host Scott Evans. The judges will now score each performance based on their artistry, technique, choreography, creativity and presentation. The top two scoring acts will move onto the "World Final" and become one step closer to winning the $1 million grand prize.

episodes.title: The Semi-finals 2
episodes.summary: In the "Semi-Final 2," the final six acts of the top twelve take to the iconic World of Dance stage for the first time this season with judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough, NE-YO and host Scott Evans. The judges will once-again score each performance based on their artistry, technique, choreography, creativity and presentation. The top two scoring acts will move onto the "World Final" and become one step closer to winning the $1 grand prize.

episodes.title: The World Final
episodes.summary: In the season four finale of "World of Dance," the top four acts take the stage for the last time in the "World Final" with judges Jennifer Lopez, Derek Hough, NE-YO and host Scott Evans. Competing for the title of Best in the World, the judges will score their performances based on their artistry, technique, choreography, creativity and presentation. The top overall scoring act will be crowned the "World of Dance" season four champion and win the grand prize of $1 million.
